shared_elements: band of repeated linear pattern (chevrons in A, feather rows in B)
justification: Both are tan stone panels in shallow relief that combine profile creature heads, a small round disc motif and zones of repeated linear patterning, which gives a generic family resemblance. But A stacks many small, flat, schematic animals in horizontal registers across a narrow pillar, while B is dominated by one large, carefully modelled winged anthropomorphic figure filling the whole rectangular slab with dense, disciplined incised detail.
